worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.summary: Gather all your light into one point and fire a high-speed lance: it deals special damage to the first foe and can pierce through further targets in a line (fading with each), possibly lowering each one's Sp. Def by 1 stage. Walls stop it.
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.use.0: Clear a row of foes in one shot
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.use.1: Pierce and wear down the Sp. Def of everyone along a line
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.use.2: A precise mid-to-long range single-target shot
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.descriptio: It can pierce %1$s further targets, keeping %2$s of its power after each one.
Each target it hits has a %1$s chance to lose %2$s stage(s) of Sp. Def, taking heavier special attacks afterwards.
It gathers for %1$s, then the lance flies at %2$s blocks per tick up to %3$s blocks with a %4$s block trace radius; walls stop it, and it dissipates when it hits a wall or nothing.
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.growth.0: From level %1$s the lance rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.flashcannon.preference: On: power ×1.2, only the first target, −3 ticks cooldown — for naming one target. Off (pierce): power ×0.92, pierces 2 further targets (fading each), +3 ticks cooldown — for clearing a line.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it gather light from further away.
On: in pierce form, when another foe stands behind the target on the same line, this move ranks higher. Focus form or when off, it ranks like an ordinary ranged attack.
